basic_details.job_title: ESIC Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 24 Medical Officer Ayurveda Posts
basic_details.short_information: The official notice does not specify the pay, the age limit, the application fee or the selection process.

qualification.details: The notice does not print the qualification, experience or maximum age for either post. It states that all details such as qualifications, maximum age and reservations are available on the website of the National Institute of Ayurveda, www.nia.nic.in. Candidates should check the discipline-specific eligibility of each post in the official notification there.

how_to_apply: Go to the website of the National Institute of Ayurveda, www.nia.nic.in.
Fill the application online. The notice says applications are to be filled online only on this website.
Submit the application between 16 November 2026 and 15 December 2026.
As of 6 November 2026, online filling has not yet started. The notice does not describe further steps, documents or fee payment.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Recruitment 2026 Overview
content_sections.text: The official notice does not specify the pay, the age limit, the application fee or the selection process.

rows.details: Employees' State Insurance Corporation, Govt. of India

content_sections.heading: About ESIC
content_sections.text: The notice is issued in the name of the Employees' State Insurance Corporation, Govt. of India, and is signed by the Joint Director (Recruitment). It points candidates to the website of the National Institute of Ayurveda for the full details and for the online application.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice announces 24 vacancies in total: 19 + 5. The category-wise break-up (reservations) is not printed in the notice; it is available on www.nia.nic.in .

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The notice does not print the qualification, experience or maximum age for either post. It states that all details such as qualifications, maximum age and reservations are available on the website of the National Institute of Ayurveda, www.nia.nic.in . Candidates should check the discipline-specific eligibility of each post in the official notification there.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ESIC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Go to the website of the National Institute of Ayurveda, www.nia.nic.in . Fill the application online. The notice says applications are to be filled online only on this website. Submit the application between 16 November 2026 and 15 December 2026. As of 6 November 2026, online filling has not yet started. The notice does not describe further steps, documents or fee payment.

rows.event: Start of online filling of applications

rows.details: Online application on the National Institute of Ayurveda website

faq.question: Q1. How many Medical Officer posts are there in ESIC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 24 posts: 19 Medical Officer (Ayurveda) and 5 Medical Officer (Homeopathy).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the ESIC Medical Officer posts?
faq.answer: The closing date for online applications is 15 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. When does online application start?
faq.answer: Online filling of applications starts on 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for ESIC Medical Officer (Ayurveda) or (Homeopathy)?
faq.answer: Applications are to be filled online only on the website of the National Institute of Ayurveda, www.nia.nic.in.

faq.question: Q5. Where can I find the qualification, maximum age and reservation details?
faq.answer: The notice says that qualifications, maximum age, reservations and other details are available on www.nia.nic.in.

faq.question: Q6. How will the Medical Officer posts be filled?
faq.answer: The posts are to be filled by direct recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the advertisement number of this notice?
faq.answer: The notice number is A/184/2026-Exam (E 1762090), dated 06-11-2026.
